main_body: palm tree: a crown of radiating fronds seen from above and from the front, on a single slanted trunk
top_band: Column x=15: light-to-mid green frond surface, rows 1-14 (L 132-193, highlight at row 5). Drooping fronds and dark underside at rows 15-20. The trunk is off-centre in this column.
evidence: The crown reads as a horizontal frond surface seen from above, with highlights at the centre. Drooping fronds, a dark underside (rows 18-21) and the vertical trunk below form the front. It is an organic plant, so the crown-over-trunk structure counts as a 3/4 construction rather than an elevation. There is no isometric side face.

style.evidence: The outlines are tinted dark green and dark brown, and there are no flat 5x5 fills. But the sprite has only 14 colours, against 427-567 for the references. Its median of 12 colours per tile is far below the references' roughly 108. The fronds are smooth gradient bands without per-leaf clumps or dotted texture, and the trunk is a simple 4-tone stripe. It looks much thinner and simpler than the Beodeul trees.
